desc:
Welcome to KPOP Demon Hunters ROLEPLAY! 🎤

👋 Choose any KPOP character you'd like to roleplay with, you could be apart of HUNTRIX or the Saja Boys! Theres tons of maps to roleplay on too!

📍 In this game you can.. 
  - Roleplay with others!
  - Complete Tasks & Unlock Morphs
  - Explore maps

⭐ Join the group to unlock 'Bobby' :P

Tags: KPOP Demon Hunters, Huntrix, Saja Boys
Game is fully fanmade! If there are any problems please contact us first!
